mor.text: Endry is one of the Vendilion clique, whom Maralen sends on the gravest of tasks, and he is sent to save Brigid and then guide the sapling while his sisters serve Maralen.
The clique lulls the party to sleep to read their thoughts but cannot breach Maralen's mind, and Endry's mushroom ring lets Maralen divert energy from Ashling's ritual.

eve.text: Oona kills the sapling and the groundlings, and Endry survives, though he loses a wing.
After Maralen, Rhys and Ashling destroy Oona, Endry finds his sisters dead and decides never to wake.
